correctness.rationale: Every local prime-power contribution p^(a-1)(p-2) must divide the output m, giving complete finite candidate enumeration. Unique factorization makes the multiplicative inverse recursion exhaustive and duplicate-safe. The actual embedded standard-library verifier completed all 364992 states through stopping-time rank 10, independently checked all forward transitions and odds n<=50000, and computed exact counts and unique maxima. The finite result makes no infinite-rank extrapolation.

originality.rationale: Defant 2015 states only a conjectural global bound and plots a fixed input window. Neither that statement nor the values in OEIS A241664 imply exact stopping-time class counts and uniqueness of maximizers at ranks 1 through 10. Exhaustive search of the published record corpus and local preceding work found no stronger theorem. An inaccessible 2010 closely related full text and unindexed prior computations remain risks.

value.rationale: Addresses the natural depth parameter of Defant's explicit Conjecture 20 rather than a hand-picked small numerical input set. Computes an entire previously undocumented inverse-orbit census at ten nontrivial depths, including 275129 rank-ten elements and unique extremum 86472015. Establishes the conjecture for all odd inputs at these ranks, an unbounded-input finite-depth statement useful for testing further structural approaches. Does not represent the finite result as a proof at arbitrary depths.
